Given the visual clarity of the gold rim, edge bleeding is likely minimal, but the internal components (pointer vs. face) may have slight fusion issues typical of AI generation.

The `perceptual_quality_auditor` noted slight compression, which is negligible compared to the semantic text failure.

I agree with the severity of the text artifact (4.0-4.5). It is catastrophic for this class. The central mechanism anomaly is moderate (2.0).
